model:
rachana: 1
sutra: party
version: 2
description: 
match: { kind: party, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Politics and society · Party", id: "$.PARTY_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Party", bind: "$.NAME", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Country", bind: "$.COUNTRY_NAME" }
  - { label: "Seats", bind: "$.SEATS", fmt: "amount0" }
  - { label: "Seat share, %", bind: "$.SEAT_SHARE", fmt: "pc1" }
  - { label: "Chamber", bind: "$.CHAMBER" }
  - { label: "Election", bind: "$.ELECTION_DATE" }
panels:
  - id: results
    kind: hbar
    title: "Seats in the chamber"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.RESULTS"
    label: "PARTY"
    value: "SEATS"
    fmt: "amount0"
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
keys: { F7: "link($.ELECTION, 'election')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
